\noindent\textbf{Superseded partial approvals.}
Equation~\eqref{eq:protocol-release} governs normal settlement and
repayment.  A separate local terminal transition applies when an
authenticated, successfully applied public payment under the same
organization configuration consumes an ordinary or user-funded fee
input instance that the member had locked for a different fact.
Before replacing the local spend candidate, the follower reloads the
immutable approval and checks the exact output instance, the distinct
fact and transaction, and the absence of observed execution, installed
or queued certificate material, pending obligations, compensation,
recovery, or any fee effect.

The member then returns, for every recorded local debit $d$, exactly
$d.\mathsf{Cap}-\mathsf{Applied}$ from Reserved to Available in the
original resource slice and records the approval as invalidated by the
first successful conflicting fact and height.  It does not set
\textsf{Settled}, close a fee escrow, modify the approval, clear other
input locks, or change public state.  The cumulative
$\mathsf{Applied}$ vector makes the transition idempotent when several
inputs of one approval conflict or a block is replayed.  Retries, late
\texttt{INSTALL}, and source recovery for an invalidated fact are
rejected.  A timeout, \texttt{INSTALL} alone, or a global Intent
conflict between disjoint inputs does not authorize this release.

\noindent\textbf{被公共冲突取代的局部批准。}
公式~\eqref{eq:protocol-release}处理正常结算与回款。
另有一条仅作用于成员本地状态的终止路径：同一组织配置下，
一个经认证且成功应用的公共付款消费了某个普通输入或用户
FUEL输入实例，而该成员此前已为另一个事实锁定了该实例。
在覆盖本地候选事实之前，Follower重新读取不可变Approval，
核对精确的输出实例、不同的事实与交易，并要求该旧事实没有
已观察执行、已安装或已排队的证书材料，也没有Pending、赔付、
回款或任何费用效果。

随后，对Approval记录的每项本地Debit，成员仅将
$d.\mathsf{Cap}-\mathsf{Applied}$从原资源Slice的Reserved退回
Available，并记录首个使其失效的成功公共事实及高度。
该转换不设置\textsf{Settled}，不关闭费用托管，不修改Approval，
不清除其他输入锁，也不改变公共状态。累计
$\mathsf{Applied}$向量保证同一Approval的多个输入发生冲突或
区块重放时至多回收一次。失效事实的重试、迟到
\texttt{INSTALL}和来源恢复均被拒绝。仅有超时、
\texttt{INSTALL}，或独立输入之间的全局Intent冲突，都不授权
这一回收。

\begin{lemma}[Superseded partial approval]
\label{lem:security-superseded}
Fix one four-member organization with three signatures required and at
most one Byzantine member.  Let an honest member have approved fact
$c$ and locked an ordinary or user-funded fee input instance $\xi$.
If a successfully applied public payment under the same organization
configuration carries a valid QC for a different fact $c'$ and consumes
$\xi$, then $c$ has no valid QC.  The honest member may therefore
restore the residual local debits of $c$ while permanently refusing to
sign or install $c$.  This conclusion does not apply to two
QC-bearing facts with disjoint inputs that conflict only through their
global Intent.
\end{lemma}

\begin{IEEEproof}
The public execution of $c'$ has passed the current organization's
authorization checks and therefore carries a valid three-member QC.
Assume for contradiction that $c$ also has a valid three-member QC.
The two signer sets intersect in at least two members.  Since at most
one member is Byzantine, an honest member belongs to the intersection.
That member would have signed two different facts that consume the
same instance $\xi$, although honest members atomically lock ordinary
and user-funded fee instances before signing and reject a different
candidate for a locked instance.  This contradicts the approval rule.

Thus $c\notin C_g$, the set of facts whose three signatures have
existed.  Restoring one member's residual debits for $c$ cannot remove
a capacity witness for any term of $Q_g$.  The successful public
consumption of $\xi$, the immutable approval, and the invalidated
progress record continue to reject later use of $c$; only its unused
local resource reservation is restored.
\end{IEEEproof}

For a fact $c\in C_g$, Lemma~\ref{lem:security-superseded}
rules out invalidation by an honest signer: such an invalidation would
require a conflicting successfully applied fact and would imply
$c\notin C_g$.  Therefore, until the member observes the successful
execution of $c$, its CAL restoration for $c$ remains zero and
$r_{m,c}=a_c\ge w_c$.  After that execution, the original repayment
argument applies unchanged: the recorded net compensation is zero,
$r_{m,c}=0$, and $w_c=0$.

Approval, ordinary settlement, and superseding invalidation move local
capacity monotonically between Available and Reserved, while top-ups
increase the member share.  Hence
$L_{m,g}\le s(B_{m,g})\le s(B_g)$.  By
Lemma~\ref{lem:security-superseded}, invalidation can reduce
$L_{m,g}$ only for a fact outside $C_g$; consequently the counting
lower bound over the signers of facts in $C_g$ is unchanged.

A partial approval remains charged until either its own payment
executes or authenticated public history proves that one of its locked
instances was consumed by a different successfully authorized fact
under the same configuration.  Time alone never releases it.
A disjoint-input payment that loses a global Intent conflict may still
have a valid QC and issuer liability, and therefore retains its input
locks and signing reservation.

\begin{lemma}[被公共冲突取代的局部批准]
\label{lem:security-superseded-zh}
考虑一个固定四成员、三签生效且至多一名成员为拜占庭的组织。
设诚实成员已经为事实$c$批准并锁定普通输入或用户FUEL输入实例
$\xi$。若同一组织配置下，一个成功应用的公共付款携带不同事实
$c'$的有效QC并消费$\xi$，则$c$不可能拥有有效QC。
因此，该诚实成员可以回收$c$尚未使用的本地资源扣留，同时永久
拒绝再次签署或安装$c$。该结论不适用于输入互不相交、仅因全局
Intent冲突而不能同时执行的两个已获证事实。
\end{lemma}

\begin{IEEEproof}
事实$c'$的公共执行已经通过当前组织的授权检查，因此携带有效的
三成员QC。反设$c$也拥有三成员QC。两个三成员签名集合至少相交
两名成员，而组织中至多一名为拜占庭成员，故交集中至少有一名
诚实成员。该成员将为两个消费同一实例$\xi$的不同事实签名；
但诚实成员在签名前原子锁定普通输入和用户FUEL输入，并拒绝为
已锁实例的不同候选事实签名，矛盾。

因此$c\notin C_g$，其中$C_g$是已经存在三份签名的事实集合。
回收成员为$c$保留的剩余本地Debit，不会删除$Q_g$中任何事实的
容量见证。实例$\xi$的成功公共消费、不可变Approval及失效进度
记录仍会拒绝$c$的后续使用；被恢复的仅是尚未使用的本地资源额度。
\end{IEEEproof}

对任意$c\in C_g$，引理~\ref{lem:security-superseded-zh}排除了诚实
签名者将其标记为失效的可能：这种失效需要一个成功应用的冲突事实，
并会推出$c\notin C_g$。因此，在成员观察到$c$成功执行之前，
其对$c$的CAL恢复量仍为零，故$r_{m,c}=a_c\ge w_c$。
成功执行之后，原有回款论证保持不变：记录的净赔付为零，
$r_{m,c}=0$且$w_c=0$。

批准、正常结算和冲突失效只会单调地在本地Available与Reserved之间
移动容量，而补资增加成员份额，因此
$L_{m,g}\le s(B_{m,g})\le s(B_g)$。
由引理~\ref{lem:security-superseded-zh}，失效只能降低不属于$C_g$
的事实所占容量，故针对$C_g$中证书签名者的计数下界保持不变。

\noindent\textbf{Local invalidation write set and replay.}
Invalidation is evaluated only while applying an authenticated block
entry whose execution result is successful and applied; \texttt{INSTALL}
does not trigger it.  Before the follower overwrites a spend record, it
reads the previous candidate and verifies the immutable approval and
the exact ordinary or user-fee input instance.  Existing observation,
installed certificate material, an outbox entry, settlement, pending
obligations, compensation, recovery, or a fee effect is treated as an
accounting contradiction rather than as releasable state.

The atomic write set contains only the affected local resource slices
and the approval's local progress.  For each debit it subtracts
$\mathsf{Cap}-\mathsf{Applied}$ from Reserved, adds the same amount to
Available, sets the corresponding cumulative Applied entry to Cap,
and records Invalidated, the first triggering public fact, and its
height.  The immutable approval and unrelated input locks remain.
Overlay visibility makes later conflicting inputs or transactions in
the same block no-ops for restoration; the follower cursor suppresses
block replay, and the cumulative Applied vector prevents a second
credit after restart.  The member-store schema is advanced so that an
older binary cannot silently ignore the invalidated terminal state.

A fully certified source that is permanently rejected by the global
Intent binding while spending disjoint inputs is outside this
invalidation rule: its QC-backed responsibility, input locks, and
signing reservation remain.  The current relay may continue retrying
such a source; terminating those retries is a separate engineering
follow-up and cannot release the certified liability.

\noindent\textbf{本地失效的写集与重放。}
失效判断仅发生在应用认证区块中执行成功且确实生效的付款记录时；
\texttt{INSTALL}不能触发失效。在Follower覆盖Spend记录之前，
它读取原Candidate，并核对不可变Approval以及精确的普通输入或
用户费用输入实例。若旧事实已经被观察、已有安装证书材料或outbox，
或已经发生结算、Pending、赔付、回款或费用效果，则将其视为会计
状态矛盾并停止处理，而不是释放容量。

该原子转换只写入受影响的本地资源Slice和Approval的LocalProgress。
对每项Debit，它从Reserved减去
$\mathsf{Cap}-\mathsf{Applied}$，向Available增加同量，将累计
Applied置为Cap，并记录Invalidated、首个触发失效的公共事实及高度。
不可变Approval和其他输入锁保持不变。同一Overlay使同一区块中后续
冲突输入或交易不再重复回收；Follower游标抑制区块重放，累计
Applied向量防止重启后再次入账。成员存储Schema相应升级，避免旧
二进制忽略新的失效终态。

独立输入上已经形成QC、但因全局Intent绑定而永久被拒绝的来源不适用
上述失效规则：其QC责任、输入锁和签发容量继续保留。当前Relay可能
持续重试该来源；终止此类重试属于独立的工程后续工作，并不得因此
释放已获证责任。
